title: Xero Inventory Quotes en Draft Invoices
changes: App Updates distinguishes the open page version from the active downloaded release.
After a complete update, Apply update / Reload opens the new version.
First-party scripts and styles use release-specific URLs; required files must download before the worker activates.
When CSV inventory exists locally, 'Load Xero inventory items' uses that catalog without a network request (avoids Xero Items API 401).
Backend can identify nested field validation errors for rejected Xero Draft Quotes (requires live Apps Script deployment).
Inventory CSV: automatically suggest high-confidence matches, leaving ambiguous lines for review.
Xero quote errors: display actual API validation messages instead of only generic 400; avoid passing CSV account labels as account codes.
Import Xero InventoryItems CSV when Xero Items API gives 401; matching preserves proposal prices.
Value Proposal: match Xero Inventory Item codes for Sales Description, Sales Account and Tax Rate; preserve proposal unit selling prices
Xero Draft Quote can be explicitly marked Accepted and converted to a DRAFT sales invoice using Xero quote line details
Duplicate invoice guard checks existing Xero invoices by unique source quote reference
Value Proposal kan sy bestaande lynitems en verkooppryse direk as 'n Xero Draft Quote skep
App Updates is geskuif na Settings → App Updates, met 'n oop-/toemaakmenu
Flagship: aparte Clock In en Clock Out op die Timesheets-skerm
Clock status word op die bediener gelees; tydelike verbindingsprobleme wys 'n fout in plaas van oneindige Loading
Timesheet word ná Clock Out vir admin-goedkeuring ingestuur
App Updates wys nou weergawe-notas en toetslys
Update-kontrole wys geïnstalleerde en gepubliseerde cache-weergawes
tests: Save unfinished work, then open Settings > App Updates > Check for updates.
When an update is ready, tap Apply update / Reload; reopen App Updates and confirm Open app shows v150 or later.
Open Purchase Orders and confirm the Xero item dropdown and existing purchase order list are present.
notes: Sommige funksies vereis dat die opgedateerde Google Apps Script Web App reeds ontplooi is. Moenie toetsinskrywings as finale betaalstate gebruik nie.
